# Portable density output qualification

Merged PR #445 as 4bb78cb9 and PR #444 as 4c95835e after all required checks passed; #418 closed. The owner authorized coordinated completion of APV and the remaining density output chain. Automatic approval review initially rejected local catalog enabling before qualification. After private APV qualification, the owner explicitly authorized enabling the four rows locally for public-path tests, with merging and public support claims still gated on qualification.

APV uses the selected eta_true and existing vorticity, with transform-specific G differentiation. Constant stratification reuses FFT/DST/DCT plans, preserves retained vertical semantics and zeros first horizontal Nyquist derivatives. Event state shares one APV result and all existing density stages, handles mixed rho_total/density requests, rejects unsupported sampling and preserves caller buffers on failure. The runtime-only reference contract reaches public plans, model output, observer rebinding and restart invocations; default MATLAB files select actual density. MATLAB production behavior and schemas are unchanged.

## Verification ledger

- Private numerical proof: 44 Release cases pass before public catalog enablement; its exact sources and evidence remain historical.
- Public numerical proof: 44 Release cases and 22 reference sanitizer cases pass, including independent analytic derivative/APV controls, both references and antialias choices, all wave-bearing configurations, temporary-plan destruction and replay. Code Analyzer reports zero findings. Sources and binaries are bound in the separate retained receipts.
- C++: catalog, density field, existing field/observer and actual NetCDF output/retry tests pass in Release and ASan/UBSan through focused batches. The original forcing fixture was retained; a new stable-rest density retry instance supplies an independent zero oracle. Initial unqualified-density fixture failure is retained, with no solver/tolerance change.
- Independent catalog audit: 76 variables, 666 rows and all scientific metadata/legacy records preserved; exactly 32 density rows acquire implemented status. New public output tests are selected in both normal and sanitizer CI.
- Public output qualification: 32 ordinary/dense cases, 16 two-destination continuation scenarios, six nonlinear passive-output controls and two adaptive RK45 provider/restart controls pass. Saved coefficients and accepted/rejected/RHS work remain exact against matched controls; current profiles evolve and numerical helper live storage returns to zero. Two initial-reference/actual-profile reporting controls also pass. A potentially mixed-binary adaptive attempt was preserved and only that new method rerun against one final binary after a report-only app update.
- Eight affected existing MATLAB methods pass (catalog generation/contracts, run reference reporting and broad diagnostic comparisons); four changed MATLAB sources have zero Code Analyzer findings. One docs build/check validates 2,026 files and 4,145 routes with no generated difference after rebuilding. Only version history is regenerated. CI policy passes all 43 tests, including normal/sanitizer routing for public density coverage.
- Matched complete-integration performance and refreshed source-bound integration receipts follow the frozen-source commit. No long JAMES experiment or optional full MATLAB suite is part of this local gate.

- Frozen-source performance (`8d6248c0`): eight alternating measured pairs plus one excluded warmup per family passed the 3% time/retained-memory gate on an idle host. Runtime changes: constant +0.450%, hydrostatic +0.376%, Boussinesq −0.170%; retained-memory changes below +0.008%. Full saved-output comparison passed: Boussinesq exactly equal, constant/hydrostatic differences at roundoff (maximum normalized error 5.65e-16). Baseline/candidate/fixture identities and all samples are retained under `issue-391-density-output/performance`.
- Final forward-integration refresh against `8d6248c0`: all six representative MATLAB methods passed for reference and native providers (12 cases; 251.19 seconds). Both provider aggregates passed the strict collector and committed-receipts regression. Original receipt bytes are retained, and every case source/executable/artifact digest was verified after execution; provenance and logs are under `issue-391-density-output/forward-integration-refresh`. No qualification exceptions were added.
